The piezoelectric film 30 has a surface roughness value P-V of not more than 170.0 nm, which is defined by a difference between a maximum height (peak value P) and a minimum height (valley value V) on a film surface, a piezoelectric constant d<SB>31</SB>greater than 150 pc/N and a breakdown voltage of 80 V or more, which is defined by an applied voltage that results in a current value of 1 μA or more.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "e0051b8a9cb6d8f25bafcd6906ad512e28320a90bd47a12bf3c38dd0b8d4bdc7", "title_text_id": "581d086c2a72b3b3e9fc35c0ee049c8cc0a95659d9cf1db7c0a0f7ad3fcae9c9", "abstract_text_id": "16fa71cd51306307ccd4bbb016143ca566add4afe9819ca9eebb232e99f9cf9d", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "2009-02-17", "selection_role": "near_center", "center_cosine": 0.9003983736038208, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 206159, "family_id": "google:53004031", "pub_id": "WO2015064423A1", "publication_id": "WO-2015064423-A1", "title": "Piezoelectric element and method for manufacturing piezoelectric element", "abstract": "The present invention provides a highly stable piezoelectric element operating at high efficiency, and a method for manufacturing such a piezoelectric element. According to one aspect of the present invention, a piezoelectric element (10) has a laminated structure in which a first electrode (14), a first piezoelectric film (16), a second electrode (18), a bonding layer (20), an intermediate layer (22), a third electrode (24), a second piezoelectric film (26), and a fourth electrode (28) are laminated in the stated order on a silicon substrate (12). The intermediate layer (22) is made of a material different from that of the second electrode (18), the thickness of the intermediate layer (22) being 0.4µm or greater and 10 µm or less. A portion of the silicon substrate (12) is removed, and a device having a diaphragm structure or a cantilever structure is formed. The ability to operate at both high and low frequencies may be tuned during use of the device to adaptively adjust for optimal resolution at a particular penetration depth of interest. In embodiments, various sizes of piezoelectric membranes are fabricated for tuning resonance frequency across the membranes. The variously sized piezoelectric membranes are lumped together by two or more separate electrode rails, enabling independent addressing between the two or more subgroups of sized transducer elements. Signal processing of the drive and/or response signals generated and/or received from each of the two or more electrode rails may achieve a variety of operative modes for the device, such as a near field mode, a far field mode, and an ultra wide bandwidth mode.", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "4190167e7d1e584e11028f9e17a5943ca6983cde2d173456b4c7df6142a036aa", "title_text_id": "7ac35c81beca67f5ea03c1d9da4e1a80ec830f9ee63ebd1c6ba32b695f81403f", "abstract_text_id": "3959345c43fd164c4b9b2f064b0abf81248be42124ea88487e243a8a1a1ecbd1", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "2012-05-01", "selection_role": "edge", "center_cosine": 0.6853293180465698, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 205888, "family_id": "google:52776400", "pub_id": "EP3053203A1", "publication_id": "EP-3053203-A1", "title": "Piezoelectric ultrasonic transducer array with switched operational modes", "abstract": "Switchable micromachined transducer arrays are described where one or more switches, or relays, are monolithically integrated with transducer elements in a piezoelectric micromachined transducer array (pMUT). In embodiments, a MEMS switch is implemented on the same substrate as the transducer array for switching operational modes of the transducer array. In embodiments, a plurality of transducers are interconnected in parallel through MEMS switch(es) in a first operational mode (e.g., a drive mode) during a first time period, and are then interconnected through the MEMS switch(es) with at least some of the transducers in series in a second operational mode (e.g., a sense mode) during a second time period.", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "7e49de2ef453c805f6b08c354e9140ba09724097eda4f9e39f49fdb38e50a3de", "title_text_id": "57bfa748c5c5dd9997a2a40900899570e3e571abe0cdf0a8ab19f318f974bf11", "abstract_text_id": "1d51e6aa997b9b6887b2fb8529386a210f1ebc4d951329fc4d4a0b7ca07ce425", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "2013-10-03", "selection_role": "edge", "center_cosine": 0.641202986240387, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 141394, "family_id": "google:35905714", "pub_id": "JP2006041007A", "publication_id": "JP-2006041007-A", "title": "Piezoelectric element and its manufacturing method", "abstract": "<P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of manufacturing a piezoelectric element which can prevent faults by internal defects and holes.  <P>SOLUTION: Fine particles, each of which is a raw material for the piezoelectric element, are sintered to make an ingot consiting of a fine particle sintered body. Then, the ingot is sliced into a plate-like piezoelectric body 206, which is then ground and thinned into a piezoelectric plate. The piezoelectric plate is divided into piezoelectric elements. When sintering the fine particles, a cavity 210 remains and will become an internal defect or hole of the piezoelectric element. In order to avoid this, the sliced plate-like piezoelectric body 206 is dipped in an insulating liquid 304. Since the plate-like piezoelectric body 206 is a fine particle sintered body, the insulating liquid 304 permeates along the grain boundaries of the fine particles 202 (304A) and thereby the cavity 210 is filled with the insulating liquid 304 (304B). Thereafter, a wiring layer is formed to join a flexible cable 34. In this state, after an AC electric field of not smaller than a coercive electric field is impressed, a positive voltage is applied to the upper electrode 18 making the lower electrode 14 the ground, and an electric field is applied to the piezoelectric film.
